title: Conditioning of solutions to the Sylvester equation
summary: We partially answer an open problem, posed by Nick Higham, concerning the conditioning of solutions to Sylvester and Lyapunov equations. The question arises in the backward stability analysis of numerical algorithms for these equations. We first show that the solution to the Sylvester equation $AX-XB = C$ can be arbitrarily ill-conditioned even if $A, B, C$ and the Kronecker sum $I \otimes A - B^T \otimes I$ are all perfectly conditioned.
